title: add-rag-agent-templates-tool-calling-examples-and-docs-update
author: Asha Patel
description: Adds RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates, new tool-calling examples in Python and TypeScript, and corresponding quickstarts and docs site updates. Motivation: provide turnkey examples for teams adopting agents+tools workflows and reduce friction integrating external tools via the tool-calling API. This PR includes template prompt artifacts, a reference agent implementation that demonstrates tool discovery, sanitization, and structured output parsing, plus docs walkthroughs and sidebar navigation updates. Non-breaking runtime shim added to propagate tool metadata in agent context; noop for existing customers. Checklist: [x] add templates and template metadata; [x] add Python & TS examples and test harnesses; [x] add quickstart guides and screenshots; [x] update docs site navigation and mkdocs config; [x] fix docs build warnings. Linked Linear: ENG-4321, PM-212. See commits and CI for details.
